description:
The testjig has 5 compile errors from the metadata-server and metadata-types -02 rewrites (JMAP-ua37.1 + .2):

1. `jmap_metadata_server::memory::MemoryBackend` — no longer exists (memory feature removed)
2. `register_metadata_handlers` — no longer exists (no standalone handlers in -02)
3. `jmap_metadata_types::Metadata` — type eliminated in -02
4. Three uses of the above in http.rs (register_all_extensions) and sse.rs (state tracking)

**Fix:**
- Remove metadata MemoryBackend construction + register_metadata_handlers call from http.rs
- Remove Metadata type from SSE/WS state snapshot tracking in sse.rs
- Keep the metadata capability URI in the Session JSON (advertise urn:ietf:params:jmap:metadata with dataTypes listing which types opted in)
- Update Cargo.toml: jmap-metadata-server dep no longer needs features=["memory"] (already done) and jmap-metadata-types dep stays for capability types

Per-extension-server MemoryBackend integration (filter matching, /changes, /set validation) is tracked separately at JMAP-s4kp.
title: Fix testjig compile errors for metadata-02
